title: Every exchange crystallizes · said, counted, crystallized, added

reference.grammar: Four panels on black: a message and its answer as dots, the counts split into two strands, a crystal, and the steps they add to the helix.

techniques.name: One dot per character

panels.title: Every exchange crystallizes · said, counted, crystallized, added

techniques.implementation: Every character of a record is one dot; position comes from the model, tone from who wrote it.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
